descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a people person? Do you know how to spread your enthusiasm about Hedge Funds to others? We are looking for someone who can help us to:

• focus on Hedge Funds distribution in the Unified Global Alternatives business covering Wealth Management in Southeast Asia
• advise Wealth Management clients on the Hedge Fund product offering and the Hedge Fund allocation in their portfolios
• directly engage with clients in collaboration with client advisors to discuss and implement the clients' preferred strategy in Hedge Funds
• provide after-sales service for clients with Hedge Fund investments and prepare client reviews
• drive the Hedge Funds business and contribute ideas to developing the product offering
• work closely with the Global Hedge Fund team to leverage full capabilities
